title: MV Yanfly PartySystem - Remove Command Not Functioning Properly

posts.author: DellTron
posts.body:
Hello, my apologies if this has been answered, but I cannot find it via a search. I am using RPG Maker MV.
I am trying to remove the "Remove" command from YanFly's PartySystem. The plugin file says to simply leave the "Remove" option blank to not have it appear on the menu. The problem is that is still appears as a blank box, and I can still remove party members from the party.
I have attached a few images to illustrate the issue I am having. The "Remove" command, while blank with no text, still shows a box I can select and then click on to remove members of the party, which I do not want. A fix would be to lock all party members, but the UI still shows I can select above and below the party list, and the UI of this would not be desirable for me.
If anybody knows any way of removing the Remove option for Yanfly's PartySystem plugin, that would be great. Thanks!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Open the plugin file in a text editor, go to line 1115, and comment it out with // at the beginning.
Untested, but that should do it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
just one added hint:
whenever yanfly plugins cause strange errors or behave in a strange way, you should check if their order is the correct one.
all of them need to be in exactly the order given on yanfly's website, top to bottom.
you can leave some plugins out and add plugins from other programmers between, but the order of yanfly plugins should be exactly like listed.
